Term1: Bacteremia associated with citrobacter freundii, klebsiella aerogenes or enterobacter cloacae
Text:
# BACTEREMIA ASSOCIATED WITH CITROBACTER FREUNDII, KLEBSIELLA AEROGENES OR ENTEROBACTER CLOACAE

Treatment for non-ESBL producing organisms (e.g. CTX-M negative on BCID Biofire)
Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h ($$) [R]
Treatment for ESBL producing organisms (e.g. CTX-M positive on BCID Biofire)
Ertapenem 1 gm IV q24h ($$) [R,DI,O]

# Duration of therapy

Treat for a total of 7 days with source control.  Most patients can rapidly transition to an oral antibiotic. Call Infectious Diseases or Stewardship Team for more information.

Therapy: ## Identification and treatment of the source of infection, in addition to antimicrobial therapy, is crucial for resolution of infection. This may include removal of catheters and draining of abscesses if present.
